dimensions.sql: SELECT "Market", SUM(CASE WHEN strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') >= TIMESTAMP '2017-04-01' AND strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') < TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01' THEN CAST("Order Item Total" AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) END) AS base_value, SUM(CASE WHEN strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') >= TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01' AND strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') < TIMESTAMP '2017-10-01' THEN CAST("Order Item Total" AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) END) AS compare_value FROM dataco WHERE strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') >= TIMESTAMP '2017-04-01' AND strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') < TIMESTAMP '2017-10-01' GROUP BY "Market" LIMIT 100000

explanation.summary: Doanh thu quý 3/2017 giảm 1.283.400,00 so với quý 2/2017, từ 9.402.500,00 xuống 8.119.100,00. Thị trường Europe giảm nhiều nhất (giảm 639.780,25), sau đó là LATAM (giảm 339.049,50). Phần lớn mức giảm do số đơn ít đi, từ 5.000 xuống 4.400 đơn (giảm 1.117.725,00); giá trị đơn trung bình giảm từ 1.880,50 xuống 1.845,25 (giảm 165.675,00). Nếu số đơn giữ như quý 2/2017, doanh thu quý 3/2017 là 9.226.250,00.

volume_price.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') >= TIMESTAMP '2017-04-01' AND strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') < TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01' THEN "Order Id" END) AS base_volume, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') >= TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01' AND strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') < TIMESTAMP '2017-10-01' THEN "Order Id" END) AS compare_volume, SUM(CASE WHEN strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') >= TIMESTAMP '2017-04-01' AND strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') < TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01' THEN CAST("Order Item Total" AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) END) AS base_value, SUM(CASE WHEN strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') >= TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01' AND strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') < TIMESTAMP '2017-10-01' THEN CAST("Order Item Total" AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) END) AS compare_value FROM dataco WHERE strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') >= TIMESTAMP '2017-04-01' AND strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') < TIMESTAMP '2017-10-01' LIMIT 100000
